basic.name: El'druin's Might
basic.description: Throw El'druin to the target area, dealing 110~~0.04~~ damage to nearby enemies and Slowing them by 30% for 2.5 seconds. It can be reactivated within 5 seconds to teleport Tyrael to El'druin and Slow nearby enemies again.

basic.name: Righteousness
basic.description: Shields Tyrael for 350~~0.04~~ damage and nearby allied Heroes and Minions for 40% as much for 4 seconds.

basic.name: Smite
basic.description: Rake target area, dealing 150~~0.04~~ damage. For the next 3 seconds, allies moving through the targeted area gain 25% increased Movement Speed for 2 seconds.

basic.name: El'druin's Flash
basic.description: Teleport to El'druin, slowing nearby enemies by 30% for 2 seconds.

heroic.name: Judgment
heroic.description: After 0.75 seconds, charge an enemy Hero, dealing 150~~0.04~~ damage and Stunning them for 1.5 seconds. Nearby enemies are knocked away and take 75~~0.04~~ damage.

heroic.name: Sanctification
heroic.description: After 0.5 seconds create a field of holy energy that makes allied Heroes Invulnerable. Lasts 3 seconds.

trait.name: Archangel's Wrath
trait.description:
Upon dying, become Invulnerable and gain 20% Movement Speed for 4 seconds. Upon expiration, explode, dealing 450~~0.04~~ damage and reducing Tyrael's death timer by 10% per enemy Hero hit.

Archangel's Wrath reduces nearby enemy Heroes' damage by 50% while active and for 3 seconds when it expires.

trait.name: Archangel's Wrath
trait.description:
Upon dying, become Invulnerable and gain 20% Movement Speed for 4 seconds. Upon expiration, explode, dealing 450~~0.04~~ damage and reducing Tyrael's death timer by 10% per enemy Hero hit.

Archangel's Wrath reduces nearby enemy Heroes' damage by 50% while active and for 3 seconds when it expires.

activable.name: Defense of the Angels
activable.description:
Activate to gain 50 Armor for 3 seconds.

Each time Tyrael damages an enemy Hero with a Basic Attack or Basic Ability, increase the duration of this Armor bonus by 0.5 seconds.

level1.name: Salvation
level1.description: Increase the Shield amount Tyrael gains from Righteousness by 35% and heal Tyrael for 150~~0.04~~ Health if his Shield is destroyed. Does not increase the Shield amount gained by allies.

level1.name: Justice for All
level1.description: Increase the Shield applied to allies by Righteousness to 80% of the Shield gained by Tyrael.

level1.name: Ardent Restoration
level1.description:
Dealing damage to a Hero heals Tyrael for 20~~0.04~~ Health over 5 seconds. Dealing damage resets this timer, and the heal amount stacks up to 8 times.

Quest: Every Regeneration Globe gathered increases this heal amount by 1%.

level4.name: Stalwart Angel
level4.description: Gain 25 Armor while El'druin's Might is active, and for 3 seconds after teleporting.

level4.name: Reciprocate
level4.description:
When Tyrael's Shield from Righteousness expires or is destroyed, it deals 170~~0.04~~ damage to nearby Heroes and Summons.

For each enemy Hero damaged by Reciprocate or El'Druin's Might, Tyrael heals for 3% of his maximum Health.

level4.name: Divine Vigor
level4.description: If Smite hits an enemy, Tyrael's Basic Attacks within the next 4 seconds heal for 70% of the damage dealt.

level7.name: Burning Halo
level7.description: Both Tyrael and El'druin deal 12~~0.04~~ damage per second to nearby enemies. Teleporting increases this damage from Tyrael by 125% for 2 seconds.

level7.name: Purge Evil
level7.description: Each enemy Hero hit by Smite increases Tyrael's Basic Attack damage by 60% for 4 seconds.

level7.name: Swift Retribution
level7.description: Smite grants 20% more Movement Speed and also grants 25% Attack Speed for 2 seconds.

level10.name: Judgment
level10.description: After 0.75 seconds, charge an enemy Hero, dealing 150~~0.04~~ damage and Stunning them for 1.5 seconds. Nearby enemies are knocked away and take 75~~0.04~~ damage.

level10.name: Sanctification
level10.description: After 0.5 seconds create a field of holy energy that makes allied Heroes Invulnerable. Lasts 3 seconds.

level13.name: Sword of Justice
level13.description: Upon teleporting using El'druin's Might, El'druin swaps places with Tyrael, and El'druin's Might can be reactivated to teleport an additional time.

level13.name: Holy Ground
level13.description: Create a ring for 3 seconds that blocks enemies from entering the area teleported to using El'druin's Might.

level13.name: Law and Order
level13.description: Each enemy Hero hit by Smite reduces the cooldown of Righteousness by 1 second. Each allied Hero Shielded by Righteousness increases the damage of the next Smite by 35%.

level16.name: Bound by Law
level16.description: El'Druin's Might's Slow is increased to 65% for 1 second, decaying to 30% over the remaining duration.

level16.name: Horadric Reforging
level16.description: Tyrael's Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of El'druin's Might by 2 seconds.

level16.name: Smite the Wicked
level16.description: While El'druin's Might is active, and for 2 seconds after teleporting, Smite's cooldown recharges 125% faster.

level20.name: Angel of Justice
level20.description: Increases the cast range of Judgment by 50%, and reduces the cooldown by 40 seconds.

level20.name: Holy Arena
level20.description: Increase the duration of Sanctification by 1 second and increase the damage of allies inside by 25%.

level20.name: Seal of El'druin
level20.description: Using a Basic Ability grants 50% Attack Speed for 3 seconds.

level20.name: Defense of the Angels
level20.description:
Activate to gain 50 Armor for 3 seconds.

Each time Tyrael damages an enemy Hero with a Basic Attack or Basic Ability, increase the duration of this Armor bonus by 0.5 seconds.

level20.name: Aspect of Justice
level20.description: After 1.25 seconds, gain the effects of Archangel's Wrath without dying. Cooldown is reduced by 15% for each enemy Hero hit by the explosion.
